fullContentHtml:
Uttarakhand TET UTET Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttarakhand Board of School Education (UBSE) has released the notification for the Uttarakhand Teacher Eligibility Test UTET Exam 2026. The online application process for Uttarakhand TET UTET Online Form 2026 has started on 14 July 2026, and candidates can apply till 03 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Uttarakhand TET UTET Online Form 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 July 2026
  • Last Date : 03 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 August 2026
  • Modify Application Form : 08-11 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 29 September 2026
  • Admit Card : Notify Later

Application Fee

  • For Single Paper
  • UR, EWS, OBC : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : Rs. 300/-
  • For Both Paper
  • UR, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : Rs. 500/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
